headline: AI Agents Gain Direct OS Execution; Apple Mandates iOS 18 SDK

key_takeaways.title: Autonomous Computer Use APIs Released
key_takeaways.summary: Frontier models are shifting from conversational text to OS-level UI navigation. Directly relevant to our Nexus Workforce Engine and autonomous web tasks.

key_takeaways.title: Apple Sets iOS 18 SDK Deadline
key_takeaways.summary: Travellounge Mauritius and all client apps must compile with Xcode 16 / iOS 18 SDK before April 2026 to avoid App Store submission rejections.

key_takeaways.title: React 19 RC & Async Params
key_takeaways.summary: Next.js 15 and Vite 6 require awaiting dynamic params. Keep existing client projects on React 18 until next quarterly upgrade.

action_items_for_deven: Verify Travellounge mobile project builds cleanly on Xcode 16.
Maintain Gemini 2.5 Flash as primary LLM engine for cost and latency advantage.
Review client project contracts ahead of Q4 release deadlines.
